ex-1.title: Neck Flexion Stretch
ex-1.description: Gently tilt head forward bringing chin to chest. Hold 15–30 seconds.

ex-2.title: Cervical Rotation
ex-2.description: Slowly rotate head side to side, maintaining chin level. Repeat 10 times each direction.

ex-3.title: Shoulder Pendulum Swing
ex-3.description: Lean forward and let the arm swing in small circles. Gradually increase circle size.

ex-4.title: External Rotation with Band
ex-4.description: Secure resistance band at elbow height. Rotate forearm outward keeping elbow at side.

ex-5.title: Cat-Cow Stretch
ex-5.description: On hands and knees, alternate between arching and rounding the spine. 10 repetitions.

ex-6.title: Bird Dog Exercise
ex-6.description: From hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg. Hold 5 seconds. 10 reps each side.

ex-7.title: Dead Bug
ex-7.description: Lying on back with arms extended, slowly lower opposite arm and leg. Core engaged throughout.

ex-8.title: Straight Leg Raise
ex-8.description: Lying down, tighten thigh muscles and lift leg 6 inches. Hold 5 seconds. 3 sets of 10.

ex-9.title: Wall Sit
ex-9.description: Slide back down wall until knees at 90°. Hold 20–60 seconds. Repeat 5 times.

ex-10.title: Terminal Knee Extension
ex-10.description: With band behind knee, push knee straight against resistance. 3 sets of 12.

ex-11.title: Hip Bridge
ex-11.description: Lying on back with knees bent, lift hips to create straight line from shoulders to knees.

ex-12.title: Clamshell Exercise
ex-12.description: Lying on side with knees bent, open top knee while keeping feet together. 3 sets of 15.

ex-13.title: Ankle Alphabet
ex-13.description: Trace the alphabet in the air with your foot. Repeat 3 times with each foot.

ex-14.title: Calf Raise
ex-14.description: Stand on edge of step, rise up on toes then lower heels below step level. 3 sets of 15.

ex-15.title: Single-Leg Balance
ex-15.description: Stand on one leg for 30 seconds. Progress to eyes closed. 5 reps each leg.

ex-16.title: Plank Hold
ex-16.description: Maintain push-up position with forearms on ground. Hold 30–60 seconds. 3 sets.

ex-17.title: Lateral Band Walk
ex-17.description: Place band around ankles and walk sideways maintaining tension. 3 sets of 20 steps.

ex-18.title: Box Jump
ex-18.description: Jump onto a stable box/platform. Step down. Progress height gradually. 3 sets of 8.

ex-19.title: Resistance Band Row
ex-19.description: Secure band in front of you. Pull elbows back squeezing shoulder blades. 3 sets of 12.

ex-20.title: Agility Ladder Drill
ex-20.description: Perform quick feet drills through agility ladder. Various patterns. 5 min continuous.
